# spatialGE

![](reference/figures/logo.png)

An R package for visualizing and analyzing spatially-resolved
transcriptomics data from spot-based platforms (e.g., 10X Visium) and
imaging-based platforms (e.g., Xenium, CosMx). Data and results from
multiple tissue sections are stored in a single **STlist** (Spatial
Transcriptomics List) object.

## Features

- **Visualization:** `STplot`, `gene_interpolation`,
  `STplot_interpolation` for exploring gene expression in spatial
  context.
- **Spatial autocorrelation:** `SThet`, `compare_SThet` to quantify
  spatial uniformity (Moran’s I, Geary’s C) and relate it to sample
  metadata.
- **Tissue domain detection:** `STclust` for spatially-informed
  hierarchical clustering.
- **Gene set enrichment:** `STenrich` to detect gene sets with spatial
  patterns, optionally within a tissue domain.
- **Spatial gradients:** `STgradient` to find genes whose expression
  varies with distance to a tissue domain.
- **Differential expression:** `STdiff` for mixed models with spatial
  covariance, plus non-spatial Wilcoxon and t-tests.
- **Spatial niche detection:** `STniche` to identify tissue niches from
  the local spatial organization of gene sets, with `plot_stniche` for
  visualization (see below).

![spatialGE workflow](reference/figures/workflow.png)

## Spatial niche detection with STniche

`STniche` detects niches, local microenvironments where particular cell
types and molecular programs co-occur, in three steps:

1.  **Gene set scoring:** each spot or cell receives an activity score
    for every gene set of interest.
2.  **Spatial autocorrelation:** a local Moran’s I statistic (reported
    as a Z-score, Zi) measures whether each gene set is spatially
    concentrated around that location.
3.  **Clustering:** Zi profiles are clustered with model-based
    clustering, and the number of niches is chosen by BIC.

It works on spot-based (Visium) and single-cell (CosMx) data. When run
on several samples at once, niche labels (C1, C2, …) are shared and
directly comparable across samples.

``` r

library(spatialGE)

# gene_sets: a named list of character vectors, one per gene set
res <- STniche(x = stlist, gene_sets = gene_sets,
               samples = names(stlist@spatial_meta),
               ks = 10, knns = 22, out_i = TRUE, cores = 4)

st <- res[[1]]  # STlist with niche assignments
zi <- res[[2]]  # Local Moran's Z (Zi) matrix
```

`plot_stniche` visualizes the results through its `type` argument:

| `type` | Shows |
|----|----|
| `"clusters"` | Niche map of each sample |
| `"Zi"` | Local Moran’s Z of one gene set (requires `zi` and `gene_set`) |
| `"celltype_heatmap"` | Fraction of each niche’s cells belonging to each cell type |
| `"celltype_composition"` | Stacked bars of cell-type composition per niche |
| `"multi_sample_alluvial"` | Niche correspondence between samples through shared gene-set programs (requires `zi`) |

``` r

plot_stniche(st, type = "clusters", samples = "sample1")
plot_stniche(st, type = "Zi", zi = zi, gene_set = "TLS_core", samples = "sample1")
```

The STniche vignette applies these functions to two case studies: Visium
sections from renal cell carcinoma (GSE175540), where niches are
compared against pathologist-annotated tertiary lymphoid structures, and
CosMx clear cell RCC fields of view, where niches are characterized by
cell-type composition and immune signaling in IO-naive and IO-exposed
tumors.

## What’s new in 2.0.0

**New**

- `STniche` and `plot_stniche` for spatial niche detection on Visium and
  CosMx data.
- Subset an `STlist` by sample with `x[i]` (name, position, negative
  position, or logical); `length(x)` now returns the number of samples.
  `x[i, j]` and `x[[i]]` raise an error by design.
- Seurat v5 support (uses `DefaultAssay()`, sparse import) and
  [`as_Seurat()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/as_Seurat.md)
  for converting back.
- Optional on-disk (parquet) storage for data larger than memory:
  [`STlist_to_disk()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STlist_to_disk.md),
  [`STlist_to_memory()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STlist_to_memory.md),
  [`is_backed()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/is_backed.md),
  [`validate_store()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/validate_store.md).
  It adds capacity, not speed.
- Parallel processing on Windows (PSOCK backend; force it elsewhere with
  `options(spatialGE.psock = TRUE)`).
- [`filter_data()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/filter_data.md)
  now reports what it removed (`verbose = TRUE`), or that nothing was
  filtered.
- Scales to Xenium- and CosMx-sized samples (200 genes x 50,000 cells
  benchmark):
  - `filter_data` 27x faster, per-gene SD 42x, log transformation 33x
    (identical output).
  - `STdiff` t-test/Wilcoxon 17-27x faster (default `mm` path
    unchanged).
  - `STgradient` distances computed in O(n) memory (previously ~20 GB at
    50,000 cells); output is bit-identical.
  - `SThet` (default `k = NULL`) no longer builds a weights list
    (previously ~1.2 GB for 4,096 spots).

**Changes that may affect existing code**

- [`dim()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/dim.html) returns
  `c(n_genes, n_spots)` for a single sample and `NULL` for multiple
  samples; use
  [`summarize_STlist()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/summarize_STlist.md)
  for per-sample dimensions.
- `STlist` objects are validated at construction.
- Unmatched genes, annotations, or domains now raise an error instead of
  being silently ignored (`SThet(genes=)`, `STgradient(annot=, ref=)`,
  `gene_interpolation(genes=)`). Partial matches give a message naming
  what was dropped.
- [`STenrich()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STenrich.md)
  requires `annot` and `domain` together. In 1.2.x, passing only one
  silently ran the *unrestricted* analysis; regenerate those results.
- [`transform_data()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/transform_data.md)
  now populates `vst.variance.standardized` in `@gene_meta` (for `log`
  and `sct`), which now precedes `moran_i` and `geary_c`; select columns
  by name. Samples with fewer than 4 non-constant genes get a warning
  and no VST column, instead of failing.
- A Seurat object’s platform is now inferred from its image class (it
  was always assumed Visium), which affects
  [`STgradient()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STgradient.md)’s
  default `nb_dist_thr` for Xenium/CosMx imports.
- `cores=` is now honored by
  [`STlist()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STlist.md)
  and
  [`transform_data()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/transform_data.md).
  Use `cores = 1` when exact `sct` reproducibility matters on large
  samples.
- Spots are now ordered deterministically by coordinates (the third
  coordinate column, normally `xpos` then `ypos`). Values are identical
  when matched by name, but column order of `@counts`/`@tr_counts` and
  row order of `@spatial_meta` can change; address spots by `libname`,
  not position.
- Some results depend on spot order by construction (as in 1.2.x, but
  now fixed by coordinates rather than file layout):
  [`STenrich()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STenrich.md)
  p-values, `SThet(k=)` Moran’s I (up to ~0.02),
  `STgradient(distsumm = 'avg')` correlations (up to ~0.004), and
  density/jitter in
  [`plot_counts()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/plot_counts.md)
  and violin plots. For order-independent values, use
  [`SThet()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/SThet.md)
  without `k`, `distsumm = 'min'`, and a higher `reps` in
  [`STenrich()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STenrich.md).
- Negligible numeric shifts:
  [`SThet()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/SThet.md)
  default (~2e-15) and `gene_stdevs` (~1e-16). `@misc$sthet$listws` is
  no longer populated on the default path.
- Validation errors now carry the `spatialGE exception:` prefix; match
  on that rather than on exact wording.

**Fixes**

- [`pseudobulk_heatmap()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/pseudobulk_heatmap.md)
  previously displayed the *least* variable genes (CV was computed as
  mean/sd). Heatmaps from 1.2.x should be regenerated.
- `STenrich(annot=, domain=)` now works; it failed in 1.2.1 and 1.2.2. A
  single-gene set no longer crashes it.
- Objects returned by
  [`gene_interpolation()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/gene_interpolation.md)
  no longer fail `validObject()`.
- [`load_images()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/load_images.md)
  matches images by normalized sample name across all directories and
  warns on unreadable files, instead of dropping samples.
- [`STplot_interpolation()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STplot_interpolation.md)
  works with its default `genes = NULL`.
- [`STdiff()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STdiff.md)
  gives a clear error for numeric or single-group `annot=`, and no
  longer emits dplyr’s many-to-many warning.
- `transform_data(method = 'sct')` errors now name the sample and its
  dimensions; invalid `cores=` is caught on every path.
- [`pseudobulk_samples()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/pseudobulk_samples.md)
  drops constant genes with a warning instead of failing.
- [`SThet()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/SThet.md)
  works on a row-subset `@spatial_meta`;
  [`STlist()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STlist.md)
  accepts a Seurat object with `samples = NULL`;
  [`filter_data()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/filter_data.md)
  can keep exactly one spot; `Seurat_FindVariableFeatures()` accepts
  non-`dgCMatrix` input;
  [`STgradient()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STgradient.md)
  no longer leaks `pval_comment` between genes.
- All 14 documented examples now run.

**Earlier releases:** 1.2.1 added C++ speedups and GSVA scoring for
`STenrich`, domain-restricted enrichment, log distances in `STgradient`,
and
[`spatial_metadata()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/spatial_metadata.md)/[`tissue_names()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/tissue_names.md).
1.2.0 introduced `STenrich`, `STgradient`, and `STdiff`. 1.1.0 changed
`STlist` in ways incompatible with 1.0 objects.

See [NEWS.md](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/NEWS.md) for the
full list of changes.

## Installation

``` r

options(timeout = 9999999) # Avoid connection timeouts when downloading from GitHub
devtools::install_github("fridleylab/spatialGE")
```

## Documentation

- Tutorials: <https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/>
- Source code: <https://github.com/FridleyLab/spatialGE>
- **[spatialGE-Web](https://spatialge.moffitt.org):** a point-and-click
  web application for using spatialGE without coding. It supports Visium
  outputs and csv/tsv expression files paired with coordinate files.

## Citation

If you use spatialGE, please cite:

Ospina, O. E., Wilson, C. M., Soupir, A. C., Berglund, A., Smalley, I.,
Tsai, K. Y., Fridley, B. L. (2022). spatialGE: quantification and
visualization of the tumor microenvironment heterogeneity using spatial
transcriptomics. *Bioinformatics*, 38, 2645-2647.
<https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btac145>

Ospina, O. E., Manjarres-Betancur, R., Gonzalez-Calderon, G., Soupir, A.
C., Smalley, I., Tsai, K. Y., Markowitz, J., Khaled, M. L., Vallebuona,
E., Berglund, A. E., Eschrich, S. A., Yu, X., Fridley, B. L. (2025).
spatialGE is a user-friendly web application that facilitates spatial
transcriptomics data analysis. *Cancer Research*, 85(5), 848-858.
<https://doi.org/10.1158/0008-5472.CAN-24-2346>

When using `STdiff`, please also cite:

Ospina, O. E., Soupir, A. C., Manjarres-Betancur, R., Gonzalez-Calderon,
G., Yu, X., Fridley, B. L. (2024). Differential gene expression analysis
of spatial transcriptomic experiments using spatial mixed models.
*Scientific Reports*, 14, 10967.
<https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-024-61758-0>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`STclust()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STclust.md)
  : STclust: Detect clusters of spots/cells
- [`STdiff()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STdiff.md)
  : STdiff: Differential gene expression analysis for spatial
  transcriptomics data
- [`STdiff_volcano()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STdiff_volcano.md)
  : STdiff_volcano: Generates volcano plots from STdiff results
- [`STenrich()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STenrich.md)
  : STenrich
- [`STgradient()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STgradient.md)
  : STgradient: Tests of gene expression spatial gradients
- [`SThet()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/SThet.md)
  : SThet: Computes global spatial autocorrelation statistics on gene
  expression
- [`STlist-class`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STlist-class.md)
  : Definition of an STlist object class.
- [`STlist()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STlist.md)
  : STlist: Creation of STlist objects for spatial transcriptomics
  analysis
- [`STlist_to_disk()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STlist_to_disk.md)
  : STlist_to_disk: Move an STlist's count matrices to on-disk parquet
- [`STlist_to_memory()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STlist_to_memory.md)
  : STlist_to_memory: Bring an on-disk STlist back into memory
- [`STniche()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STniche.md)
  : STniche (mclust version): Detect functional spatial domains with
  model-based clustering
- [`STplot()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STplot.md)
  : STplot: Plots of gene expression, cluster memberships, and metadata
  in spatial context
- [`STplot_interpolation()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/STplot_interpolation.md)
  : STplot_interpolation: Visualize gene expression surfaces
- [`as_Seurat()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/as_Seurat.md)
  : as_Seurat: Convert an STlist to a Seurat object
- [`compare_SThet()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/compare_SThet.md)
  : compare_SThet: Compares spatial autocorrelation statistics across
  samples
- [`dim(`*`<STlist>`*`)`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/dim-STlist-method.md)
  : dim: Prints the dimensions of count arrays within an STList object.
- [`distribution_plots()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/distribution_plots.md)
  : per_unit_counts: Generates distribution plots of spot/cell meta data
  or gene expression
- [`filter_data()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/filter_data.md)
  : filter_data: Filters cells/spots, genes, or samples
- [`gene_interpolation()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/gene_interpolation.md)
  : gene_interpolation: Spatial interpolation of gene expression
- [`get_gene_meta()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/get_gene_meta.md)
  : get_gene_meta: Extract gene-level metadata and statistics
- [`is_backed()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/is_backed.md)
  : is_backed: Is an STlist's expression data stored on disk?
- [`load_images()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/load_images.md)
  : load_images: Place tissue images within STlist
- [`plot_counts()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/plot_counts.md)
  : plot_counts: Generates plots for the distribution of counts
- [`plot_image()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/plot_image.md)
  : plot_image: Generate a ggplot object of the tissue image
- [`plot_stniche()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/plot_stniche.md)
  : Plot STniche results
- [`pseudobulk_dim_plot()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/pseudobulk_dim_plot.md)
  : pseudobulk_dim_plot: Plot PCA of pseudobulk samples
- [`pseudobulk_heatmap()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/pseudobulk_heatmap.md)
  : pseudobulk_heatmap: Heatmap of pseudobulk samples
- [`pseudobulk_samples()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/pseudobulk_samples.md)
  : pseudobulk_samples: Aggregates counts into "pseudo bulk" samples
- [`show(`*`<STlist>`*`)`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/show-STlist-method.md)
  : show: Prints overview of STList oject.
- [`spatial_metadata()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/spatial_metadata.md)
  : spatial_metadata: Prints the names of the available spot/cell
  annotations
- [`summarize_STlist()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/summarize_STlist.md)
  : summarize_STlist: Generates a data frame with summary statistics
- [`summary(`*`<STlist>`*`)`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/summary-STlist-method.md)
  : summary: Prints overview of STList oject.
- [`tissue_names()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/tissue_names.md)
  : tissue_names: Prints the names of the tissue samples in the STlist
- [`transform_data()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/transform_data.md)
  : transform_data: Transformation of spatial transcriptomics data
- [`validate_store()`](https://fridleylab.github.io/spatialGE/reference/validate_store.md)
  : validate_store: Check an on-disk STlist against its manifests
